verdict.rationale: BILL's pricing page documents automatic 2-way sync with QuickBooks Enterprise and Oracle NetSuite (and others), and the S&E product page says every transaction is "categorized." There is no evidence of user-controlled GL account, class, or department mapping. The sync claim also comes from the general BILL pricing page rather than S&E-specific card transaction docs. missing for 10: documented GL account/class/department mapping controls, Xero support, S&E-specific transaction sync documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration
